import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

# 4B 5-seed accuracy data
cls_4b = [87.83, 89.52, 87.88, 89.00, 87.94]
cwm_4b = [87.51, 87.20, 86.98, 86.67, 87.57]

# 8B 3-seed accuracy data (for comparison)
cls_8b = [90.48, 89.40, 88.31]
cwm_8b = [87.77, 87.13, 86.51]

# === 4B Analysis ===
diffs_4b = [c - w for c, w in zip(cls_4b, cwm_4b)]
mean_gap_4b = np.mean(diffs_4b)
std_gap_4b = np.std(diffs_4b, ddof=1)

# Paired t-test
t_stat_4b, p_two_4b = stats.ttest_rel(cls_4b, cwm_4b)
p_one_4b = p_two_4b / 2  # one-sided (CLS > CWM)

# Bootstrap CI for 4B gap
np.random.seed(42)
n_boot = 10000
boot_gaps_4b = []
for _ in range(n_boot):
    idx = np.random.choice(5, 5, replace=True)
    boot_cls = [cls_4b[i] for i in idx]
    boot_cwm = [cwm_4b[i] for i in idx]
    boot_gaps_4b.append(np.mean(boot_cls) - np.mean(boot_cwm))
ci_4b = np.percentile(boot_gaps_4b, [2.5, 97.5])

# Cohen's d for 4B
cohens_d_4b = mean_gap_4b / std_gap_4b

# TOST equivalence test for 4B (margin ±2pp)
margin = 2.0
t_upper = (mean_gap_4b - margin) / (std_gap_4b / np.sqrt(5))
t_lower = (mean_gap_4b + margin) / (std_gap_4b / np.sqrt(5))
p_tost_4b = max(stats.t.cdf(t_upper, df=4), 1 - stats.t.cdf(t_lower, df=4))

# === 8B Analysis (recompute for consistency) ===
diffs_8b = [c - w for c, w in zip(cls_8b, cwm_8b)]
mean_gap_8b = np.mean(diffs_8b)
std_gap_8b = np.std(diffs_8b, ddof=1)
t_stat_8b, p_two_8b = stats.ttest_rel(cls_8b, cwm_8b)
p_one_8b = p_two_8b / 2

boot_gaps_8b = []
for _ in range(n_boot):
    idx = np.random.choice(3, 3, replace=True)
    boot_cls = [cls_8b[i] for i in idx]
    boot_cwm = [cwm_8b[i] for i in idx]
    boot_gaps_8b.append(np.mean(boot_cls) - np.mean(boot_cwm))

cohens_d_8b = mean_gap_8b / std_gap_8b

# === Scaling comparison ===
gap_increase = mean_gap_8b - mean_gap_4b
# Bootstrap P(8B gap > 4B gap)
p_scaling = np.mean([g8 > g4 for g8, g4 in zip(
    np.random.choice(boot_gaps_8b, n_boot),
    np.random.choice(boot_gaps_4b, n_boot)
)])

# Print all results

print("4B CLS vs CWM (5 seeds)")
print(f"  Paired diffs: {diffs_4b}")
print(f"  Mean gap: {mean_gap_4b:.2f}pp")
print(f"  Std: {std_gap_4b:.2f}")
print(f"  Paired t-test: t={t_stat_4b:.2f}, p(one-sided)={p_one_4b:.4f}")

print(f"  Cohen's d: {cohens_d_4b:.2f}")
print(f"  TOST p (margin ±2pp): {p_tost_4b:.4f}")
print()
print("8B CLS vs CWM (3 seeds)")
print(f"  Paired diffs: {diffs_8b}")
print(f"  Mean gap: {mean_gap_8b:.2f}pp")
print(f"  Std: {std_gap_8b:.2f}")
print(f"  Paired t-test: t={t_stat_8b:.2f}, p(one-sided)={p_one_8b:.4f}")
print(f"  Bootstrap 95% CI: [{ci_8b[0]:.2f}, {ci_8b[1]:.2f}]pp")
print(f"  Cohen's d: {cohens_d_8b:.2f}")
print()
print("Scaling comparison")
print(f"  Gap increase: {mean_gap_4b:.2f} → {mean_gap_8b:.2f} (+{gap_increase:.2f}pp)")
print(f"  P(8B gap > 4B gap): {p_scaling:.3f}")
print("=" * 60)

# Save results
import json
results = {
    "4B": {
        "seeds": 5,
        "cls_accuracies": cls_4b,
        "cwm_accuracies": cwm_4b,
